production.note: US model years 2021-2023. First: Ford's 2021 US Mustang brochure introduces the Mach 1. Last: Ford Authority (Alex Luft) calls 2023 'the ninth and final model year of the pony car's sixth generation' and lists the 2023 Mach 1 (fordauthority-mustang-2023).

displacementL.note: '5.0L'. No opened page prints the cc figure; Cars.com lists '5.0 L/302' (cars-com-2022-mach-1).

transmission.note: 'TREMEC TR-3160 6-speed manual transmission with Rev Matching' and '10-speed SelectShift automatic transmission'.

powerHp.note: Rating for model years 2022-2023, which cover two of the three years. The Drive (Chris Tsui, 13 October 2021): "the Mach 1's motor is brought down to 470 horses instead of the current version's 480", with Ford's statement: "horsepower and torque has been reduced by 10 hp and 10 pound-feet for 2022 model year Mustangs with the 5.0-liter V8 engine." Ford Authority (Alex Luft) for 2023: "Mach 1 | Naturally aspirated 5.0L V8 Coyote | Gasoline | Six-speed manual | RWD | 470 @ 7250" (fordauthority-mustang-2023). Two named-author outlets agree. The 2021 car was rated 480 hp: Ford's 2021 brochure, '480 HORSEPOWER' (ford-us-mustang-brochure-2021).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL, from databases. Mach 1 fastback, 6-speed manual (the standard transmission). Cars.com 2022: base curb weight '3,868 lbs'. MotorMatchup, 2023 Mach 1 Fastback with 'Transmission: 6-speed Manual': "Curb Weight: 3,868 lbs" (motormatchup-2023-mach-1). Cars.com gives the same 3,868 lb for 2021 (cars-com-2021-mach-1).

sources.publisher: Ford Motor Company (brochure hosted by auto-brochures.com)
sources.title: Ford Mustang brochure (US, 2021 model year)
2022 Ford Mustang's 5.0L V8 Down 10 HP to Meet Emissions Standards (Chris Tsui)

discrepancies.reason: Model year: 480 hp for 2021, 470 hp for 2022-2023 after an emissions recalibration.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 470 hp, the rating for two of the three model years; reference year 2022.

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 3,868 lb rests on Cars.com (2021 and 2022) and MotorMatchup (2023, manual), all databases. A Ford specification sheet or a major magazine's spec panel for the 2022 Mach 1 manual would replace it. Power (470 hp) rests on two named-author outlets, not a Ford document.
